findings.evidence: `Spa/RationalSubset/Basis.lean:121–132` defines `spaRationalFamily` using `IsOpen (Ideal.span (T : Set A))`; `StructurePresheaf/Basic.lean:98–111` likewise explicitly identifies openness of the numerator ideal as the defining rationality condition.
findings.fix: Describe `hspan` as the stronger unit-ideal generation hypothesis needed by `isStronglyNoetherian_completion`, and remove claims that it is free for arbitrary rational-subset presentations.
findings.issue: Lines 32–34, 68, 75, 87–95, 467, 515, and 542–559 call `Ideal.span (insert s T) = ⊤` the rational-subset condition and claim it is automatic by definition; in this library rationality requires openness of the numerator ideal, not unit-ideal generation.

summary: The documentation misidentifies the unit-ideal hypothesis as the defining rational-subset condition, materially understating the theorem's assumptions.
